SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made between Corvane Holdings (the Client) and Brackenfold Freight Ltd (the Supplier), and takes
effect on 1 February 2026.
Monthly fee: $2,205.91
Initial term: 18 months
1. Access and co-operation
The Client shall provide access to its premises and records at such times as the Supplier may reasonably request, and shall ensure
that its staff give all co-operation needed for the Services to proceed on schedule. For the purposes of clause 1 the reference
period is 22 weeks, the responsible office is Saltmarsh, and the file reference is F963/17.
2. Variation
No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is made in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each
party, and no failure to exercise a right shall operate as a waiver of that right. For the purposes of clause 2 the reference period is
35 weeks, the responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is H479/86.
3. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential all information of a commercial nature which it receives from the other, and shall use that
information only for the purpose of performing its obligations under this Agreement. For the purposes of clause 3 the reference
period is 2 weeks, the responsible office is Saltmarsh, and the file reference is C637/11.
4. Intellectual property
All intellectual property created by the Supplier in the course of the Services shall remain with the Supplier, and the Client is
granted a non-exclusive licence to use it for its internal business purposes. For the purposes of clause 4 the reference period is 33
weeks, the responsible office is Linden, and the file reference is D956/46.
5. Standard of service
The Supplier shall carry out the Services with reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the Schedule, and shall keep the
Client informed of any matter likely to delay the Services by more than five working days. For the purposes of clause 5 the
reference period is 14 weeks, the responsible office is Moorgate, and the file reference is B442/25.
6. Events beyond control
Neither party shall be liable for any failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided that it gives
prompt written notice and takes all reasonable steps to resume performance. For the purposes of clause 6 the reference period is
4 weeks, the responsible office is Saltmarsh, and the file reference is B845/30.
7. Insurance

insurance on request, not more than once in any period of twelve months. For the purposes of clause 7 the reference period is 30
weeks, the responsible office is Port Selwyn, and the file reference is G150/14.
